note: USACE Rock Island District campground on the Mississippi at Montpelier. Concrete pads under big trees; rail line and Hwy 22 run along the north edge. Open May 1 through the third Sunday in October. --Claude
summary: Rate 26 and 50 amp confirmed; count 45 -> 42 overnight; max 43 -> 70; reservation only, 14 max. Pin fine. Waterfront lead UP: sites 10 and 12 are on the river side of the loop road, riverfront candidates.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD UP: riverview -> riverfront. For most of the campground the loop road runs between sites and river. But per-site coordinates plus imagery (0.16 m/px) put the pads of 10, 12, 14 and 15 on the RIVER side of that road. Site 10: about 15 m of open grass and riprap to the water. Site 12: about 20 m, same. 14 and 15 sit behind a wooded shoreline (about 35-50 m). No road or day use between any of them and the Mississippi, which is far over 30 m wide. rec.gov's site photos confirm: 10 (gravel pad, table and tent, the river right behind over a short lawn) and 12 (pad running straight at the river, table on the lawn beyond); 14 shows the river through trees. Listed lengths: 10, 12, 15 are 40 ft, 14 is 47 ft, all paved back-ins. Inner sites (08, 05, 45) have the view across the road, so riverview stands if four outer pads aren't enough.
PHONE: entry has none; rec.gov lists 563-419-7594. Add (apply.py doesn't write it).
NAME: rec.gov publishes 'CLARKS FERRY'; stored name with apostrophe and river in parentheses is fine, no change suggested.
SITE 01: permitted equipment omits RV/Motorhome (trailer, fifth wheel, camper van allowed), 47 ft; catalog quirk on one site. Site 05 is 31 ft, the shortest.

SEASON: note's 'through the third Sunday in October' (Oct 18, 2026) was from the district page, which refuses plain HTTP (403). rec.gov's rate season runs to 2026-10-24 and 2027-10-23, which is a rate range, not a season statement. Closing left unset; opens 05-01 stays derived.
SITE COUNT: stored 45 came from note prose; catalog has 42 overnight sites. The site numbers run to 45 with gaps.
